---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature for MASROUTER Desktop
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve.
Link to a real workflow that hurts today. The more concrete, the better.

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is the proposed solution
better?

## Use case

Describe a specific scenario in which this feature would help. Who is
the user? What are they doing? What stops them from doing it today?

## Out of scope (optional)

What is explicitly **not** part of this request? This helps reviewers
understand where the boundary is.

## Additional context

Mock-ups, links to related issues, references to the paper — anything
that helps the discussion.
